residents.name: Tullius Inian
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Master Armorer
residents.bark: Legion steel takes three quenches in rainwater before it holds an edge worth carrying on the roads.

residents.name: Claudia Rosentia
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Apothecary
residents.bark: Measure the Nirnroot tincture by the drop, or your heart will race faster than a Cheydinhal courier.

residents.name: Rashid Tide-Runner
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Publican
residents.bark: Wipe your boots at the threshold—mud from the county road dries like mortar on my floorboards.

residents.name: Nadia Shetcombe
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Mercantile Factor
residents.bark: Every crate bears the Office of Imperial Commerce seal, and every coin goes into the ledger before sundown.

residents.name: Faendil Oak-Leaf
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Chapel Primate
residents.bark: The Nine ask for steady hands and honest weights long before they ask for gilded candles.

residents.name: Vivienne Leland
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Folio-Keeper
residents.bark: Ayleid Rubbings and Elder Council gazettes sell out faster than penny romances these days.

residents.name: Lucian Bruiant
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Clothier
residents.bark: You can tell a Colovian officer from a Nibenese magistrate by the weight of the wool alone.

residents.name: Valeria Inian
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Goldsmith
residents.bark: Valus gold and Ayleid meteoric glass require a steadier loupe than most apprentices possess.

residents.name: Farid Shetcombe
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Watch Sergeant
residents.bark: Keep your blade peace-bonded inside the gates and the County Watch will have no quarrel with you.

residents.name: Samira Tide-Runner
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Freeholder
residents.bark: Three dry days on the furrow and the wheat stands tall enough to hide a legionary.

residents.name: Caenlorn Oak-Leaf
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Weir-Miller
residents.bark: When the river runs high with silt, we dress the millstones twice a week just to keep the flour white.

residents.name: Odette Belette
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Sawyer
residents.bark: Great Forest oak seasons hard as iron if you fell it in the waning frost.

residents.name: Varian Valerius
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Vein-Cutter
residents.bark: Timber the gallery roof before you swing the pick, or the karst will settle the debt for you.

residents.name: Flavia Bruiant
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Net-Master
residents.bark: Rumare slaughterfish will take three fingers off a careless hand before the net hits the gunwale.

residents.name: Rashid Harbour-Watch
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Forester
residents.bark: Venison for the Count's table, wolf-pelts for the courier cloaks, and an arrow notched for highwaymen.

residents.name: Nadia Shetcombe
residents.title: Gottshaw Inn Lyrist
residents.bark: Every county seat claims Saint Alessia rested under its oak, and every county pays well to hear it sung.
